extracted.intended_audience: candidates for the certificat de mathématiques générales, engineers, and physicists (students of École Centrale and similar technical schools)
extracted.subtask_description: A French textbook (Paul Appell) giving foundational elements of mathematical analysis aimed at engineers, physicists, and candidates for general mathematics certification; covers functions, continuity, derivatives, Taylor's formula, partial derivatives, infinitesimals, integrals, vector analysis, differential equations, and applications.
